description: This file defines the DropfilesType class, a custom Symfony form type for uploading files with Dropzone integration, supporting multiple file uploads, file transformations, and handling different document types.

classes.name: DropfilesType
classes.description: A custom Symfony form type for uploading files via Dropzone, supporting multiple file uploads, file transformations, and different document types.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form by adding fields and transformers for current files, uploads, removed files, and view transformations.

methods.name: addCurrentViewAndModelTransformer
methods.description: Adds the 'current' file field with model transformer.

methods.name: addUploadsFieldModelTransformer
methods.description: Adds model transformer to 'uploads' based on type (document or contract).

methods.name: addUploadsTransformerAsDocument
methods.description: Transforms uploaded images into BaseDocument instances.

methods.name: addUploadsTransformerAsContractDocument
methods.description: Transforms uploaded images into Document instances.

methods.name: addRemovedFieldModelTransformer
methods.description: Transforms 'removed' field data into appropriate document/image objects.

methods.name: addViewTransformer
methods.description: Adds view transformer to handle display and submission data transformations.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering the form view.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix for the form type.
